name: docsway-dev
description: Development and test environment for the Docsway WordPress plugin.

scripts.seed: wp-env run cli wp eval-file bin/seed.php
scripts.seed:divi: wp-env run cli wp eval-file bin/seed.php divi
scripts.reset: wp-env clean all && npm run seed
scripts.lint:php: wp-env run cli bash -c 'find wp-content/plugins/aneris-docsway wp-content/plugins/aneris-docsway-pro -name "*.php" -exec php -l {} \; | grep -v "No syntax errors" || true'
scripts.plugin-check: wp-env run tests-cli bash -c 'wp plugin is-installed plugin-check || wp plugin install plugin-check; wp plugin activate plugin-check --quiet; wp plugin check aneris-docsway; status=$?; wp plugin deactivate plugin-check --quiet; exit $status'
scripts.demo:start: npm run demo:content && cd demo && wp-env start
scripts.demo:build: npm run demo:content && cd demo && wp-env run cli wp docsway-demo build
scripts.demo:zip: npm run demo:content && bash bin/zip.sh aneris-docsway-demo demo
